import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# secondary structure records for chain B around 322-360
print("HELIX/SHEET records touching RDE-2 326-360:")
for ln in open("8q66.pdb"):
    if ln.startswith("HELIX") and ln[19]=="B":
        s,e=int(ln[21:25]),int(ln[33:37])
        if s<400: print("  HELIX", s,"-",e)
    if ln.startswith("SHEET") and ln[21]=="B":
        s,e=int(ln[22:26]),int(ln[33:37])
        if s<400: print("  SHEET", s,"-",e)

# CA coords
def ca(path, chain):
    d={}
    for ln in open(path):
        if ln.startswith("ATOM") and ln[12:16].strip()=="CA" and ln[21]==chain:
            d[int(ln[22:26])]=np.array([float(ln[30:38]),float(ln[38:46]),float(ln[46:54])])
    return d
xtal=ca("8q66.pdb","B"); af=ca("AF-Q19672.pdb","A")
common=sorted(set(xtal)&set(af)); print("\ncommon CA:",len(common), common[0],"-",common[-1])
P=np.array([af[i] for i in common]); Q=np.array([xtal[i] for i in common])
def kabsch_rmsd(P,Q):
    Pc=P-P.mean(0); Qc=Q-Q.mean(0)
    V,S,Wt=np.linalg.svd(Pc.T@Qc); d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(V@Wt))
    D=np.diag([1,1,d]); U=V@D@Wt
    Pr=Pc@U
    return np.sqrt(((Pr-Qc)**2).sum(1).mean()), Pr, Qc
rms,Pr,Qc = kabsch_rmsd(P,Q)
print("Global CA RMSD AlphaFold monomer vs 8Q66 chain B (326-567): %.2f A" % rms)
# core-only (exclude 326-355 tail)
core=[i for i,r in enumerate(common) if r>=356]
rms_core,_,_ = kabsch_rmsd(P[core],Q[core]); print("Core 356-567 only CA RMSD: %.2f A" % rms_core)

pl=np.load("plddt.npy")
print("\nAlphaFold pLDDT over the crystallographically ordered MUT-7-binding extension 326-355: mean %.1f (max %.1f)"
      % (pl[325:355].mean(), pl[325:355].max()))
print("AlphaFold pLDDT over CTD core 356-567: mean %.1f" % pl[355:567].mean())
print("AlphaFold pLDDT over N-PLD 1-45: mean %.1f" % pl[:45].mean())

iface=[329,330,332,334,343,344,345,346,348,349,352,376,383,393,425,426,428,429,430,432,434,461,462,463,464,465,466,468,491,492,495,534,535,536,537,548,551,563,565,566,567]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(13,3.6))
ax.plot(range(1,579), pl, color="#4a5568", lw=1, label="AlphaFold pLDDT (monomer)")
ax.axhline(70, ls="--", c="grey", lw=.8)
ax.axvspan(1,45,color="#d69e2e",alpha=.3)
ax.axvspan(216,294,color="#9f7aea",alpha=.25); ax.axvspan(297,350,color="#9f7aea",alpha=.25)
ax.axvspan(326,567,color="#38a169",alpha=.12)
ax.scatter(iface,[3]*len(iface),marker="|",s=200,color="#c53030",label="RDE-2 residues contacting MUT-7 in 8Q66 (<4 A)")
ax.set_xlim(1,578); ax.set_ylim(0,105); ax.set_xlabel("RDE-2/MUT-8 residue"); ax.set_ylabel("pLDDT")
ax.set_title("MUT-7 binding is a folded C-terminal domain (8Q66, 326-567), not an IDR function; 10 of 41 interface residues fall in the 329-349 coupled-folding extension")
ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc="upper left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
